source: original unseeded standard-v15 PARX60 root prefixes;authenticated source/input hashes from earlier native audit
design_status: exploratory follow-up after failed first-order holdout repairs;not a new held-out/generalization score

budget.prior_archive_and_diagnostic_durations: separately retained in manifests and receipts;not called zero;no cold or equal-end-to-end ratio
budget.timeouts: parent terminates entire child process group at180s;last atomic checkpoint retained;no fresh automatic budget

matching.domain: only observed source root passenger adjacencies
matching.variables: binary y_uv;at most one predecessor and successor;sum y=n-8
matching.objective: minimize sum edge ranks;rank by frequency descending,source start minute,source id,successor id
matching.tie_policy: Gurobi seed0,threads1;equal rank sums resolved by that fixed solver;no row permutations or parameter tuning

safe_path_no_good.precondition: registered complete fixed-sequence event graph returns no terminal candidate with empty other-bus reservations;no physical replay/technical error is accepted as this proof
safe_path_no_good.formula: sum(y_uv for internal consecutive path arcs)-sum(y_us for arcs entering first node)-sum(y_tv for arcs leaving last node)<=len(path)-2
safe_path_no_good.proof: Unit predecessor/successor matching:violation iff every internal arc is selected and both endpoints are unmatched to outside nodes,i.e.the exact forbidden whole path is a connected component. Extensions,subpaths and alternate predecessor/successor choices remain allowed. Additional buses cannot restore reachability lost without their reservations. Scope is specified event graph,not continuous physics.
safe_path_no_good.tests: 225 exhaustive acyclic4-node component checks and actual Gurobi endpoint-extension smoke passed

shared_conflict_policy.rule: every path must first pass empty-reservation test;shared-guided no-terminal or overloaded schedules never create path-infeasibility no-goods
shared_conflict_policy.alternative_enumeration: exclude only the already-visited complete matching after a first-order shared retiming miss;this is explicitly heuristic enumeration and can skip another timing realization of a feasible matching

hit: exactly8 independently replayed schedules,all source trips exactly once,zero minute plug overload,grid/continuous physical chronology and energy/cost block checks using registered independent replay
null_and_failure_outcomes: no further observed matching after cuts/enumeration

physics.plugs: original finite opportunity and unlimited PARX

resources.resource_reason: Three independent streamed-root/small matching MIPs and fixed-sequence graphs;all-case concurrency3;prior lightweight root cases fit4GiB;hard180s worker cap plus source/setup/replay bookkeeping under10min.

publication: No Git push or Docs edits by this task;source/protocol frozen remotely and hashed before job start;raw licensed artifacts private.
